development_exposure_disclosure: Before the derivation seals, official/search identity pages exposed titles, record identifiers, dataset categories, row counts and some sample-condition metadata: BMRB 68 reports 556 proton chemical shifts; BMRB 16582 reports 643 coupling constants; BMRB 52365 names chemical shifts, T1, T1rho, heteronuclear NOE and RDC data for a ubiquitin folding intermediate; BMRB 27257 reports two hydrogen-exchange-rate sets with 138 rows. IUPAC search material disclosed only reporting concepts and units. No numeric NMR-STAR shift, coupling, relaxation or exchange value vector was opened, captured or reconstructed before the native laws and target identities were fixed. Exposed metadata is never relabelled blind.
